svg.title: The same idea in many languages
svg.desc: Three speech bubbles showing one idea — a greeting of peace — in three languages. The first reads the Arabic "السلام عليكم" (as-salaamu alaykum) with a note "adds: a blessing wished on the other person." The second reads the Hebrew "שלום" (shalom) with a note "adds: peace and wholeness, also hello and goodbye." The third reads "peace be with you" with a note "says it plainly, loses the blessing and the wholeness." A bottom line reads "the same idea, and each language keeps something the others let go." Labels and shapes, not color alone, carry the meaning so the graphic prints clearly in grayscale.
svg.text: The Same Idea in Many Languages
one idea — a greeting of peace
adds: a blessing wished on the other person
adds: peace and wholeness — also hello and goodbye
says it plainly — lets the blessing and the wholeness go
Each keeps something the others let go.
That is gained and lost — a richness, not a flaw.
